plain: In 1975, near Carman, Manitoba, in Canada, an object people called "the ping pong ball" was seen and photographed on a second night of sightings, "jumping around the sky." The researcher Grant Cameron, who says he was there, tells Michels that watching it fly away that night made him decide to find out what was going on. He says that search led him from the Canadian government to an American named Eric A. Walker.
